targeting.metaDescription: Format dates in n8n with tested Luxon examples. Fix Invalid DateTime, timezone shifts, Unix timestamps and Code node errors, including DST edge cases.
targeting.excerpt: A practical n8n date-formatting guide with copy-ready expressions, Date & Time node setup, timezone conversion, Unix units, invalid-date validation, DST boundaries and tested Code node examples.
targeting.keywords: n8n date format, n8n date format expression, n8n invalid datetime, n8n convert unix timestamp to date, n8n date timezone, n8n today date format, n8n date comparison, n8n add days to date, n8n date to string, n8n luxon
